metadata.title: Sign In
metadata.description: Sign in to your Princeps workspace.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email or username.
login.errorFallback: Sign in failed. Please try again.
login.freeHint: It's free — no credit card required.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.subtitle: Sign up with your email address.
signUp.usernameHint: Must be unique. You can use it to sign in.
signUp.errorFallback: Sign up failed. Please try again.
signUp.freeHint: Free forever — no credit card required.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email address and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account with that email exists, you'll receive a reset link shortly.

metadata.title: New Password
metadata.description: Set a new password for your Princeps account.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter your new password below.
resetPassword.successMessage: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
resetPassword.errorFallback: Reset failed. Please request a new link.
resetPassword.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
